name: Tmc2209 → Currents
description: Change the motor currents at runtime.

config_entries.label: Hold Current
config_entries.description: The motor current at standstill, in A RMS. Cannot be used together with `ihold`.

config_entries.label: Ihold
config_entries.description: The hold current as a raw driver value, `0` to `31`. Cannot be used together with `hold_current`.

config_entries.label: Iholddelay
config_entries.description: How gradually the current is lowered from the run current to the hold current, `0` to `15`. `0` switches at once.

config_entries.label: Irun
config_entries.description: The run current as a raw driver value, `0` to `31`. Cannot be used together with `run_current`.

config_entries.label: Run Current
config_entries.description: The motor current while running, in A RMS. Cannot be used together with `irun`.

config_entries.label: Standstill Mode
config_entries.description: What the driver does at standstill when the hold current is zero. Only works in StealthChop mode. One of:

options.label: coil_short_ls
options.description: The coils are shorted through the low side switches (passive braking).

options.label: coil_short_hs
options.description: The coils are shorted through the high side switches (passive braking).

config_entries.label: Tpowerdown
config_entries.description: The delay after the motor stops before the current is lowered to the hold current, `0` to `255`. Each unit is $2^{18}$ clock cycles (about 22 ms at 12 MHz). The driver default is `20`.
